exposure: Presence of a mechanical heart valve (MHV)
Presence of a tissue heart valve
Vitamin K antagonist use in the first trimester
Heparin use in the first trimester
outcome: Pregnancy free of serious adverse events
Uncomplicated pregnancy with a live birth
cohort: The study included 212 pregnant patients with a mechanical heart valve, 134 with a tissue heart valve, and 2620 without a prosthetic valve from a worldwide registry.
finding: Women with a mechanical heart valve have only a 58% chance of experiencing an uncomplicated pregnancy with a live birth, significantly lower than those with a tissue heart valve or no prosthetic valve, and face increased risks of maternal mortality, mechanical valve thrombosis, and hemorrhagic events.
country: Worldwide (as part of the ROPAC registry)
